headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录300篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究220篇, 开源项目38篇, 模型发布30篇, 产品/API12篇。热门标签：Agent（58篇）。其中16%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ moeru-ai /airi：💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them

▸ andrewyng /aisuite：Simple, unified interface to multiple Generative AI providers

▸ affaan-m /ECC：The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research

▸ huggingface /speech-to-speech：Build local voice agents with open-source models

▸ microsoft /agent-governance-toolkit：AI Agent Governance Toolkit — Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and rel
